name: Blade of Despair
passive: Unique Passive — Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2 seconds (takes effect before the damage is dealt).
description: The emerald-forged greatsword of ultimate physical devastation, granting the highest single-item Physical Attack in the Land of Dawn.
tips: Because Despair triggers before the hit lands on targets under 50% HP, it supercharges execution skills like Fanny's Cut Throat and Beatrix's Renner.
whenToBuild: When snowballing ahead on Assassins or as a 4th/5th slot capstone on Marksmen.

name: Berserker's Fury
passive: Unique Passive — Unique Attribute: +40% Crit Damage | Unique Passive — Doom: Critical strikes grant 5% extra Physical Attack for 2 seconds.
description: Brutal double-bitted battleaxe that amplifies critical strike multipliers to lethal levels.
tips: Pair with Windtalker and Haas's Claws for 60%+ Critical Chance and massive 240%+ Critical Damage.
whenToBuild: Second core item on Crit Marksmen like Layla.

name: Endless Battle
passive: Unique Passive — Divine Justice: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3 seconds deals (60% Total Physical Attack) extra True Damage and recovers 80 (+40% of Total Physical Attack) HP (1.5 seconds cooldown).
description: Official Tier-3 Attack equipment used across the Land of Dawn (Health specialization).
tips: Provides +60 Physical Attack, +5 Magic Power efficiency for Attack builds.

name: Demon Hunter Sword
passive: Unique Passive — Engulf: Basic Attacks deal 8% of the target's current HP as extra physical damage (capped at 60 against minions). | Unique Passive — Devour: Basic Attacks grant 2% Lifesteal for 3 seconds (stacks up to 5 times).
description: Demon-slaying blade whose on-hit percentage health shred tears through high-HP frontliners.
tips: Core centerpiece of the 'Trinity Build' alongside Golden Staff and Corrosion Scythe.
whenToBuild: First item on Claude and Karrie, or whenever facing high-HP Tanks/Fighters.

name: Great Dragon Spear
passive: Unique Passive — Supreme Warrior: After casting an Ultimate, increase Movement Speed by 30% for 7.5 seconds. This effect has a 15 seconds cooldown.
description: Official Tier-3 Attack equipment used across the Land of Dawn (Attack specialization).
tips: Provides +70 Physical Attack, +10% Cd Reduction efficiency for Attack builds.

name: Malefic Gun
passive: Unique Passive — Armor Buster: Increase Physical Penetration by 30%. | Unique Passive — Malefic Energy: Increases Basic Attack range by 12%. When hitting a target, gains 10% Movement Speed for 0.5 seconds.
description: Refined Leviathan Energy Rifle modeled after Layla's signature cannon, extending Basic Attack reach across the battlefield.
tips: Turns Layla into an untouchable siege turret with +15% bonus range and +20% Armor Penetration.
whenToBuild: Mid-to-late game range and penetration item for Marksmen.

name: War Axe
passive: Unique Passive — Fighting Spirit: Attacks grants 12 extra Physical Attack per second for 4 seconds, up to 6 stacks. Deals 10% extra True Damage based on the damage dealt (no damage reduction counted) at full stacks. (Marksmen, Mages, and Supports only receive 50% of these stacked effects.)
description: Blood-forged battleaxe that turns extended Fighter brawls into unstoppable True Damage rampages.
tips: At 6 stacks, War Axe provides a whopping 24% total Spell Vamp and bonus True Damage on every skill.
whenToBuild: First core item on sustained EXP Lane Fighters like Yu Zhong.

name: Malefic Roar
passive: Unique Passive — Armor Buster: Increase Physical Penetration by 30%. | Unique Passive — Breaker: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.1% extra Physical Penetration for each point of the enemy's Physical Defense, capped at 30%.
description: Twin-barreled armor-piercing revolver that punches straight through stacked tank armor.
tips: Against a Tank with 250+ Physical Defense, Malefic Roar ignores over half their armor.
whenToBuild: Whenever enemies purchase Antique Cuirass, Dominance Ice, or Blade Armor.

name: Corrosion Scythe
passive: Unique Passive — Corrosive: Basic Attacks gain 80 extra Physical Damage and slow the target by 8% (halved for ranged Basic Attacks) for 1.5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times. | Unique Passive — Impulse: Basic Attacks grant 6% extra Attack Speed for 3 seconds, capped at 5 stacks.
description: Venom-dripping war scythe that cripples enemy movement while ramping attack speed to extreme levels.
tips: Provides 60% total Attack Speed at 5 stacks while preventing enemies from walking away.
whenToBuild: First or third item in the Attack Speed Trinity build.

name: Sea Halberd
passive: Unique Passive — Lifebane: Dealing damage to a target will reduce the Shield and HP Regen effects on them to 60% of normal for 3 seconds. | Unique Passive — Punish: Increase damage by 8% against enemy heroes with higher extra HP.
description: Official Tier-3 Attack equipment used across the Land of Dawn (Attack_Speed specialization).
tips: Provides +80 Physical Attack, +20% Attack Speed efficiency for Attack builds.

name: Rose Gold Meteor
passive: Unique Passive — Dragon Scale: Every 1% Lifesteal increases Hybrid Defense by 1, up to 50 (effect is halved for non-Fighter heroes). | Unique Passive — Lifeline: When taking damage that reduces HP below 30%, gains a (120*Hero Level) shield (increases with level) and 50% Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 3 seconds. This effect has a 60 seconds cooldown.
description: Official Tier-3 Attack equipment used across the Land of Dawn (Attack_Speed specialization).
tips: Provides +40 Physical Attack, +20% Attack Speed efficiency for Attack builds.

name: Haas's Claws
passive: Unique Passive — Unique Attribute: +20% Lifesteal | Unique Passive — Frenzy: Critical strikes grant 20% extra Attack Speed for 2 seconds.
description: Official Tier-3 Attack equipment used across the Land of Dawn (Attack_Speed specialization).
tips: Provides +40 Physical Attack, +15% Attack Speed efficiency for Attack builds.

name: Haas's Claws
passive: Unique Passive — Frenzy: Critical Strikes grant +20% extra Attack Speed for 2s.

tips: Allows Marksmen to heal from 10% HP to full HP off a single jungle camp or minion wave.
whenToBuild: Third core item in Critical Strike builds or sustain slot on Beatrix.

name: Hunter Strike
passive: Unique Passive — Unique Attribute: +15 Physical Penetration | Unique Passive — Retribution: Dealing damage to the same enemy hero or creep 5 times in a row grants 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 3 seconds (8 seconds cooldown).

tips: Doubles Karrie's Lightwheel Mark stacks and Demon Hunter Sword's Devour proc on every 3rd shot.
whenToBuild: Second item immediately after Demon Hunter Sword or Corrosion Scythe.

name: Blade of the Heptaseas
passive: Unique Passive — Unique Attribute: +15 Physical Penetration | Unique Passive — Ambush: If no damage is taken or dealt within 5 seconds (excluding from Minions or Creeps), the next Basic Attack will deal an additional 160 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slow the target by 40% for 1.5 seconds.
description: Naval cutlass of the Seven Seas that rewards bush ambushes and sudden burst engagements.
tips: Clearing jungle creeps or lane minions does NOT break the Ambush passive—only hero or turret combat does!
whenToBuild: First core item on burst Assassins and ambush Fighters.

name: Wind of Nature
passive: Unique Passive — Unique Active - Wind Chant: Become immune to all Physical Damage for 2 seconds (duration is halved for non-Marksmen; 90 seconds cooldown).
active: Unique Active — Wind Chant: Becomes immune to all Physical Damage for 2s (Duration halved to 1s when used by non-Marksman heroes). 70s cooldown.
description: Elven wind-blessed bow that renders Marksmen completely untouchable by physical assassins and rival marksmen for 2 seconds.
tips: Press Wind Chant the exact moment Fanny cables toward you or an enemy Marksman opens fire.
whenToBuild: Situational 4th–6th item on Marksmen against heavy Physical Burst.

name: Windtalker
passive: Unique Passive — Typhoon: Every 5–2 seconds (reduced by 0.2 seconds for each Basic Attack), the next Basic Attack will hit up to 3 enemy units for 150–362 Magic Damage. (This attack can Crit and the damage increases to 200% against Minions.)
description: Storm-enchanted katana that accelerates waveclear and rotation speed for Critical Marksmen.
tips: Cheap first item for Layla to clear Gold Lane waves fast and kite with +20 flat Movement Speed.
whenToBuild: First item in Critical Strike Marksman builds.

name: Sky Piercer
passive: Unique Passive — Lethality: After dealing damage to an enemy hero, executes the hero if their HP is lower than 4%. Gains 10 stack(s) of Lethality for each kill and loses 30% current stack(s) for each death. Each stack of Lethality increases the HP threshold of the execute effect by 0.1%, stacking up 80 times.
description: Twin-bladed celestial halberd that instantly executes low-health enemies and snowballs up to a 12% Max HP threshold.
tips: Works on both Physical and Magic Assassins (Gusion, Aamon, Fanny, Beatrix) to guarantee targets never escape with 1 HP.
whenToBuild: Early snowball item when getting kills in the Jungle or Gold Lane.

name: Magic Blade
passive: Unique Passive — Lifeline: When taking damage that reduces HP below 30%, gains a (+60*Hero Level) shield (increases with level) and 50% Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 3 seconds. This effect has a 60 seconds cooldown.
description: Official Tier-2 Attack equipment used across the Land of Dawn (Attack specialization).
tips: Provides +35 Physical Attack, +10% Physical Lifesteal efficiency for Attack builds.

name: Swift Crossbow
passive: Unique Passive — Crossbow: Each Basic Attack deals 40 extra Adaptive Damage. | Unique Passive — Impulse: Basic Attacks grant 3% extra Attack Speed for 3 seconds, capped at 5 stacks.
description: Official Tier-2 Attack equipment used across the Land of Dawn (Attack_Speed specialization).
tips: Provides +20% Attack Speed efficiency for Attack builds.

name: Legion Sword
description: Heavy broadsword issued to officers of the Moniyan Imperial Vanguard.
tips: High raw Physical Attack component that builds into Blade of Despair, Malefic Roar, and Hunter Strike.

name: Rogue Meteor

tips: Essential crit-rate bridge for Windtalker, Berserker's Fury, and Haas's Claws.

name: Fury Hammer

whenToBuild: First item component on Fanny, Chou, or Beatrix.

name: Ogre Tomahawk
description: Official Tier-2 Attack equipment used across the Land of Dawn (Health specialization).

name: Expert Gloves

tips: Provides +30 Physical Attack efficiency for Attack builds.

name: Iron Hunting Bow
description: Official Tier-1 Attack equipment used across the Land of Dawn (Attack specialization).
tips: Provides +10 Physical Attack, +5% Cd Reduction efficiency for Attack builds.

passive: Unique Passive — Demonize: When HP drops below 40%, gains 30% Damage Reduction for 3 seconds and reduces skill cooldowns by 2 seconds. This effect has a 60 seconds cooldown. | Unique Passive — Defiance: For every 1% HP lost, damage is increased by 0.25%, up to 15%.

passive: Unique Passive — Shield: Upon taking Magic Damage from enemy hero skills or Basic Attacks, reduces Magic Damage taken by 25% for 3 second (including the damage that triggers the effect)s. Regains this effect 5 seconds after leaving combat.
description: Divine aegis that reduces incoming Magic Burst by a flat 25% for 3 seconds.
tips: The ultimate counter to one-shot Magic Assassins and Mages like Gusion, Kagura, Odette, and Aamon.
whenToBuild: Whenever enemy Gusion, Kagura, or Aamon starts snowballing.

name: Immortality
passive: Unique Passive — Immortal: Resurrect 2.5 seconds upon death and gets 16% Max HP and a shield that can absorb 150(+70*Hero Level）damage. Shield lasts 3 seconds. This effect has a 210 seconds cooldown.
description: Golden ankh shield of resurrection that grants a second life in decisive late-game teamfights.
tips: Pro tip: While reviving during the 2.5s animation, open the shop to sell Immortality and quick-buy Winter Crown!
whenToBuild: 5th or 6th slot late-game insurance on every role.

name: Chastise Pauldron
passive: Unique Passive — Chastise: Taking damage will reduce the Attack Speed and Attack Speed cap of the attacker to 75% of normal for 2 seconds. | Unique Passive — Redemption: When incoming damage reduces HP below 30%, recover 20% Max HP over the next 2 seconds. This effect has a 60 seconds cooldown.
description: Official Tier-3 Defense equipment used across the Land of Dawn (Defense specialization).
tips: Provides +900 Hp, +40 Physical Defense efficiency for Defense builds.

description: Official Tier-3 Defense equipment used across the Land of Dawn (Defense specialization).
tips: Provides +800 Hp, +20 Physical Defense efficiency for Defense builds.

name: Dominance Ice
passive: Unique Passive — Fortress Shield: For each enemy hero within 5 units, Hybrid Defense is increased by 8, up to 40. | Unique Passive — Lifebane: Taking damage will reduce the Shield and HP Regen effects of the attacker to 60% of normal for 1 second.
description: Frozen crown of the Northern Vale that cripples enemy Attack Speed and cuts healing/shields in half.
tips: First mandatory item on almost every Tank Roamer and EXP Fighter against sustain or Marksmen.
whenToBuild: First item on Tigreal, Khufra, Chou, or Yu Zhong.

name: Winter Crown
passive: Unique Passive — Unique Active - Frozen: Becomes frozen, untarge, and immune to damage for 2 seconds (100 seconds cooldown). Cannot move or cast skills while frozen, but skills already cast won't be interrupted.
active: Unique Active — Frozen: Freezes the wielder for 2s, rendering them untargetable and immune to all damage and debuffs (does NOT interrupt ongoing channeled skills like Odette's Swan Song!). 100s cooldown.
description: Glacial diadem of the Northern Vale that encases any hero in unbreakable stasis ice.
tips: Because it grants Adaptive Attack and doesn't interrupt ongoing channels, Odette can cast Swan Song and immediately freeze herself while the AoE continues wiping the enemy team!
whenToBuild: Late-game lifesaver for Mages, Assassins, Fighters, or Marksmen.

name: Blade Armor
passive: Unique Passive — Unique Attribute: +20% Crit Damage Reduction | Unique Passive — Bladed Armor: When struck by a Basic Attack, deals Physical Damage equal to 30 (+2% Total Physical Defense)% of the incoming damage (calculated before Damage Reduction) to the attacker and slows them by 15% for 1 second.
description: Razor-spiked plate armor that reflects Basic Attack volleys and reduces Critical Damage by 20%.
tips: Combined with the Vengeance battle spell, Blade Armor causes Claude, Beatrix, and Layla to eliminate themselves on your thorns!

passive: Unique Passive — Burning Soul: Deals (1.2% Total HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies per second. Stacks up to 3 times.

tips: Provides +962 Hp, +40 Magic Defense efficiency for Defense builds.

description: Official Tier-3 Defense equipment used across the Land of Dawn (Defense specialization).

passive: Unique Passive — Unique Attribute: +12% Healing Effect | Unique Passive — Blessing: When casting a healing or shield skill, if the target's HP is below 35%, or falls below 35% within 3 seconds, they will get a (100*Hero Level) shield that lasts 3 seconds.
